title: The Confident voice on the phone
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：confident　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 confident 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the musician wrote of ① a confident voice on the phone in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② more confident than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the confident ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most confident voice on the phone anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1942 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too confident to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the confident ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a confident smile at the door, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as confident as the smile at the door they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was confident or not, and he said so.

By 1955 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something confident, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite confident; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the confident ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1958, twice over, she wrote of another confident voice on the phone in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more confident than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most confident smile at the door in the whole hall, she said in 1960, was the one she could never quite name; the confident ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 自信（前置定语 a confident voice on the phone：1948 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件自信的声音）
B. adj. 自信／有把握（比较级 more confident than：文中两处，一处比电话里的声音，一处比预想）
C. adj. 自信／有把握（最高级 the most confident：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 自信（表语 too confident to do：母亲觉得它太自信，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有把握（前置定语 a confident smile at the door：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有把握的笑意）
F. adj. 有把握（同级比较 as confident as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩门口的笑意相比）
G. adj. 有把握（后置定语 something confident：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有把握（受程度副词修饰 quite confident：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a confident voice on the phone
the most confident voice on the phone anybody
a confident smile at the door
The most confident smile at the door in

answers.why: confident 意为“自信”，1948 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件自信的声音”，此处作前置定语 a confident voice on the phone。
confident 意为“自信”，此处用比较级 more confident than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
confident 意为“自信”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最自信的一件，故用最高级 the most confident voice on the phone。
confident 意为“自信”，母亲认为这件东西“太自信了，谁也用不上”，too confident to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
confident 意为“有把握”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有把握的笑意”，此处作前置定语 a confident smile at the door。
confident 意为“有把握”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩门口的笑意一样有把握”，同级比较用 as confident as。
confident 意为“有把握”，节目单上那半行字要的是“有把握的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something confident。
confident 意为“有把握”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当有把握”，quite 修饰原级 confident。
confident 意为“有把握”，1958 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要有把握”，故用比较级 more confident than。
confident 意为“有把握”，母亲 1960 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最有把握的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most confident smile at the door。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件自信的声音。（a confident voice on the phone）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更自信。（more confident than …）
母亲觉得它太自信，谁也用不上。（too confident to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有把握的笑意。（a confident smile at the door）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩门口的笑意一样有把握。（as confident as …）
到了 1955 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件有把握的东西。（something confident）
answers: In 1948 the musician wrote of a confident voice on the phone in the programme.
Everybody said it was more confident than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too confident to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a confident smile at the door.
He said nobody would call it as confident as the smile at the door they had once had.
By 1955 the programme asked for nothing but something confident.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 confident 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the musician wrote of a confident voice on the phone in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most confident voice on the phone in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too confident to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a confident smile at the door, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite confident, and everybody laughed.
The confident ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
